title: Mouse Without Borders broken on .102 release

judgment.rationale: The issue is not only a generic pairing report: its comment explicitly links #50795 and supplies the same SettingsSync rejection and signer identities. Keep #50795 as the primary tracking issue rather than proposing a competing change. Preserve primary tracking in #50795. Do not present cross-release file replacement as an approved correction or weaken signer/version checks.
evidence: The original report says MWB cannot generate a key or pair on 0.102 from Microsoft Store and that 0.101 works.

The commenter confirms the exact `untrusted-signature` rejection on 0.102.3001.0, the same signer thumbprints as #50795 assigned to opposite executables, unsuccessful key/config/service-mode resets, and a working downgrade.

Upstream main 9227a8497750 compares trusted leaf signer certificates exactly, matching #50795's established rejection: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/9227a8497750c257a0682b53c556d07f48ed8ff3/src/settings-ui/Settings.UI.Library/Utilities/NamedPipePeerVerification.cs#L265-L334
Newest comment confirms the same error and workaround; refreshed primary tracking: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/50795

A new commenter reports that replacing the three MWB launcher executables with files from another release restored pairing on two x64 machine-wide installations: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/51567#issuecomment-6482766769

This is an unofficial mixed-version workaround reported by one commenter, not independently validated, a shipped fix, or evidence covering other architectures/install scopes. A Settings executable swap reportedly caused a runner version mismatch.
